text: {"lessons":["After a prolonged decline, I should review each holding’s outlook and portfolio risk promptly, not wait for losses to become severe before acting.","I should decide position sizes and exit or review triggers in advance; selling in stages can reduce exposure without turning every decision into a reaction to a loss versus cost basis.","I should judge future trades on expected return, risk and diversification from today’s prices—not on my average cost or a brief spell of account stability."]}
